newsitem.title: USA: Arthur J. Gallagher to continue stock buys.
newsitem.headline: Arthur J. Gallagher to continue stock buys.

text.p: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co said Tuesday it will continue the plan, originally adopted on May 10, 1988, to purchase shares of its common stock for reissuance in connection with its stock option plans.
The repurchases will be made from time to time in compliance with the SEC's Rule 10b-18, the company said.
It said the plan authorizes the repurchase of 625,000 shares through June 30, 1998, at such times and prices as the company may deem advantageous.
The company pointed out there was no commitment or obligation on its part to purchase any particular amount of stock and the plan could be suspended at any time at its discretion.
On December 31, 1996, the company had 16,293,000 shares of its common stock outstanding.
